description: A Databricks pane that follows the databricks CLI: browse workspace, Unity Catalog, compute, jobs, pipelines, apps and dashboards, and see what Claude reads or changes.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: Icon set: auto uses DatabricksSymbols NF when the font is installed and your terminal started after it was installed, else Nerd Font, else plain Unicode; Nerd Font over SSH, plain Unicode in the desktop app. Pick one to force it.
